name: 1toolring
description: Pay-per-call access to thousands of tools from third-party providers through a single 1ToolRing key: web search, maps and places, shopping and prices, market data, web pages, images, weather, jobs and more. The price is shown before every call and failed calls are never charged.

description_i18n.en: Pay-per-call access to thousands of tools from third-party providers through a single 1ToolRing key: web search, maps and places, shopping and prices, market data, web pages, images, weather, jobs and more. The price is shown before every call and failed calls are never charged.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过一个 1ToolRing 密钥按次调用第三方供应商提供的数千个工具：网页搜索、地图与地点、购物与价格、行情数据、网页抓取、图片、天气、招聘等。每次调用前显示价格，失败的调用不计费。

api_key.title: 1ToolRing API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the OAuth sign-in prompt. Create a key at https://app.1toolring.com/keys.
